podcast.title: Renaming to The Fliers
podcast.body: After recording one single for John Dolphin's record label, the band renamed themselves The Fliers and subsequently moved to Fliers Records. "before renaming themselves the fliers, and moving over to flier records."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Uncredited Debenares Recording
podcast.body: The Debenares' first record was released under the name The Hollywood Blue Jays by John Dolphin, a name he used for various groups. This was a disappointment for the actual band members who expected their own name to be credited. "it wasn't credited to the Debenares, but instead to the Hollywood Blue Jays, and named Dolphin had also used for the groups."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
